initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by commit 226baefb45634f23bb3a1242ad6f48f30bcb69ed, titled "more application of 5373", which added Consent to source/resourcelist.html in the high-level resource list, local category list, and alphabetical resource table.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini actively maps Consent to consent\consent.html and source/consent/structuredefinition-Consent.xml. Current source/resourcelist.html and source/resourceguide.html include Consent under Security and Privacy. Jira search also surfaced FHIR-12921 about Consent mappings, but that is a separate CBCC mapping issue rather than this TOC/link request; Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting context.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current resource-list and resource-guide source already satisfy the FHIR-5373 request and no source correction is needed.
